judged.sentence: What they had not built was a position that could fail privately.

claims.claim: What they had not built was a position that could fail privately.
claims.why: Narrator's interpretation that LTCM's failure could not stay contained. The research only records McDonough's warning of widespread disruption (F2), not this characterization.

judged.sentence: The smartest people in the room had built a fund that could not be allowed to fail on its own.

claims.claim: The smartest people in the room had built a fund
claims.why: Rhetorical characterization of LTCM's founders; the research notes star academics and models but makes no 'smartest' judgment.

claims.claim: a fund that could not be allowed to fail on its own
claims.quote: the Federal Reserve Bank of New York organized a $3.625 billion private rescue by 14 banks and securities firms to keep the fund from disorderly liquidation
claims.why: The research records a rescue to prevent disorderly liquidation; 'could not be allowed to fail' is the narrator's interpretation of that.

judged.sentence: In September 1998, it took a different room, convened by the New York Fed, to keep that failure from spilling into the markets.

claims.claim: In September 1998, it took a different room, convened by the New York Fed
claims.quote: At the September 1998 New York Fed rescue meeting, McDonough convened 14 major Wall Street firms
claims.why: The research records a September 1998 rescue meeting convened at the New York Fed.

claims.claim: to keep that failure from spilling into the markets
claims.quote: the discussions centered on preventing a disorderly liquidation that could destabilize markets
claims.why: This paraphrases the stated purpose of preventing market destabilization.

v1Errors.sentence: Fourteen institutions committed a combined $3.625 billion, and the fund that had spent four years presenting itself as the final word on quantifiable risk passed out of its founders' control and into the hands of the creditors who had made its scale possible.
v1Errors.script_quote: the fund that had spent four years presenting itself as the final word on quantifiable risk
v1Errors.why: The research does not state that LTCM presented itself as 'the final word on quantifiable risk'; this characterization is not supported by any research passage.

v1Errors.sentence: The creditors who had extended the financing, rolled the repos, and in some cases structured special arrangements specifically to gain access to LTCM's returns now held the equity.
v1Errors.script_quote: rolled the repos, and in some cases structured special arrangements specifically to gain access to LTCM's returns
v1Errors.research_quote: UBS later wrote off $680 million after a special 1997 deal with LTCM to gain exposure
v1Errors.why: The research mentions only UBS as having a special arrangement to gain exposure; the script generalizes this to creditors plural as established fact without research support for the broader claim.
